Let me update the draft to drop `retry_safe` and `idempotent` lines, then re-verify.","tool_calls":[{"index":0,"id":"call_00_FO8wrVQ8Ha15rAWFpkQw6382","type":"function","function":{"name":"zts_expert_review_patch","arguments":"{"file": "handler.ts", "content": "import { run, step } from \"zttp:durable\";\nimport { call } from \"zttp:workflow\";\n\nstructural OrderProof<T> = Proof<T,\n  | \"deterministic\"\n  | \"state_isolated\"\n  | \"result_safe\"\n  | \"optional_safe\"\n  | \"no_secret_leakage\"\n  | \"no_credential_leakage\"\n  | \"input_validated\"\n  | \"pii_contained\"\n  | \"injection_safe\"\n  | \"canonical\"\n  | \"cost_bounded\"\n>;\n\nexport function handler(req: Request): OrderProof<Response> {\n  const key = req.headers.get(\"idempotency-key\");\n  if (key === undefined) {\n    return Response.json({ error: \"missing idempotency-key\" }, { status: 400 });\n  }\n  return run(key, () => {\n    step(\"reserve_inventory\", () => {\n      return { reserved: true, orderId: \"order-1\" };\n    });\n    const child = call(\"notify\", {});\n    return Response.json({ notified: child.status }, { status: 201 });\n  });\n}\n"}"}}]},"logprobs":null,"finish_reason":"tool_calls"}],"usage":{"prompt_tokens":28779,"completion_tokens":984,"total_tokens":29763,"prompt_tokens_details":{"cached_tokens":25856},"completion_tokens_details":{"reasoning_tokens":619},"prompt_cache_hit_tokens":25856,"prompt_cache_miss_tokens":2923},"system_fingerprint":"a26a7955944dc5c60445bff77fac9c8e"}
